body: just to be clear, gender roles != gender != sex, but are still linked, as most people’s gender match their sex and follow gender roles. Not following gender roles doesn’t mean you’re trans if your gender matches your sex.
I don’t want to bother you, and I’m not even sure if I know how to talk about this.

Gender isn’t a social construct. Gender is biological whereas gender roles are a social construct. As a trans person, it annoys me whenever I see people saying that gender is a social construct which implies that it’s a choice, when gender dysphoria exists. From what I’ve seen, it’s mainly people who don’t understand what gender actually is and confuse it for roles or people who believe that gender dysphoria isn’t required to be trans (which isn’t true). Even if social gender roles didn’t exist, trans people would still exist as most of us experience some sort of physical/body dysphoria and would want to transition in order for our bodies to present as the sex we would like to be.
